title: SOFTWARE ENGINEER
tagline: Full-stack software engineering, end to end
summary: Full-stack software engineering — real products shipped the whole way through, from database schema and backend APIs to the interface someone actually uses.
description: I build products the whole way through — database schema, backend APIs, and the interface someone actually uses. My primary stack is React, Next.js, and Ruby on Rails, with PostgreSQL underneath.

This is the foundation everything else sits on. The ERP integration work, the systems architecture, the products I've shipped independently — all of it is built on the same core discipline: write backend logic that holds up under real use, and ship an interface that doesn't get in the way.

title: ERP INTEGRATION SPECIALIST
tagline: Connecting the enterprise systems that were never built to talk
summary: Real-time data exchange across ERP and finance platforms that were never designed to talk to each other — SAP, Oracle, Dynamics 365, Sage, Odoo, and more.
description: At Solutech, I built the integration layer connecting a sales automation platform to eight major ERP and finance systems — SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Sage, Epicor iScala, Odoo, QuickBooks — plus BI tools like Power BI, Tableau, and Qlik, and payment platforms like M-Pesa.

That work is RESTful and file-based API design (CSV, XML), real-time data exchange across platforms with fundamentally different data models, and doing it reliably across manufacturing, distribution, and FMCG clients in production. This is the differentiator most engineers don't have: making enterprise systems that were never designed to talk to each other actually exchange data correctly, at scale.
